blocks.text: Runtime config separates public settings from server-only settings. Anything placed in public is visible to browser code.
Use a Nuxt 3 project for these file paths. Examples go in the files named in comments. Remove the starter welcome screen and use NuxtPage in app.vue. Nuxt code needs its own build tool.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Never put an admin key or password in public runtime config.
